estimand: Predict the direction of reported task-score differences for the fixed v5.2 model roster on future, independently reviewed benchmark families.
information_cutoff: All inputs are the sealed v5.2 release; source publications were inspected through 2026-10-12. The local seal records the later registration timestamp.
eligibility: Publish the sealed bundle before collecting outcomes. Local hashes alone are not independent registration.
Published after the seal; never previously inspected by the research team; no existing fine family or broader ancestry. Record this assessment and reasons.
At least two registered model IDs; no new model forecasting; one explicit metric direction and domain selected before scoring.
Record source URL, publication time, system conditions and unknowns. An independent reviewer accepts eligibility and comparability scope.

Log every proposed outcome and every exclusion. Collect consecutively eligible publications for 180 days after public registration; target 20 new families; report whatever accrues without significance-based stopping.
method_definitions: Three graph fits use fixed v4.2 normalizers, clipping and historical weights on all v5.2 included rows, including explicitly provisional evidence. Pair votes use family-balanced signs. AA baseline uses only AA rows at the identical cutoff. No estimator is retuned after sealing.
primary_loss: Equal-family macro directional accuracy over all observed non-tied pairs. Abstentions and zero predictions receive 0.5. Also report conditional accuracy, attempted, predicted and abstained cases per family and model.
secondary_loss: Equal-family macro Brier score. Graph probabilities use fixed sigmoid slope 1; vote probabilities use (vote+1)/2; abstentions use 0.5. These are uncalibrated forecasts whose validity is being tested.
ties: Exclude exact observed ties from directional and Brier scoring; disclose tie counts. No normalized-margin filtering in the primary analysis.
uncertainty: Publish family-level outcomes and paired method differences. Fewer than 20 families: descriptive only. Any later interval analysis must respect family dependence and be labelled secondary; raw pairs are not independent trials.
scope: Reported systems, not equal-compute intrinsic models or a universal intelligence measure. Missing outcomes are not failures or zeros. Publication bias and unknown configuration differences remain limitations.
amendments: Create a new study version and seal; never overwrite registered forecasts. Disclose deviations separately.
